display.name: BuildingBlocks Telemetry
display.description: Request health, per-component spans, .NET runtime, and log volume for services instrumented with BuildingBlocks.Telemetry. Component panels use the telemetry.component span attribute; runtime panels query both the .NET 9+ and .NET 8 metric names.

display.name: deployment.environment
display.description: Deployment environment

display.name: service.name
display.description: Service name

display.name: telemetry.component
display.description: Instrumentation component (aspnetcore, httpclient, npgsql, sqlclient, mediator, eventbus, ...). Defaults to all components.

display.name: Request rate
display.description: Inbound HTTP requests per second

display.name: P95 latency
display.description: P95 inbound HTTP request duration

display.name: Server error rate
display.description: Rate of inbound HTTP requests answered with a 5xx status code

display.name: Active requests
display.description: HTTP requests currently being processed

display.name: Request duration (P50 / P95 / P99)
display.description: Inbound HTTP request duration percentiles

display.name: Request rate by status code
display.description: Inbound HTTP request rate grouped by response status code

display.name: Request rate by route
display.description: Inbound HTTP request rate grouped by matched route template

display.name: Spans by component
display.description: Span count grouped by the telemetry.component attribute

display.name: P95 span duration by component
display.description: P95 span duration grouped by the telemetry.component attribute

display.name: Error spans by component
display.description: Spans with error status grouped by the telemetry.component attribute

filter.expression: (service.name = $service.name AND telemetry.component IN $telemetry.component AND has_error = true)

display.name: Slowest operations (P95)
display.description: P95 span duration grouped by span name

display.name: GC heap size
display.description: Managed heap size. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: GC collection rate
display.description: Garbage collections per second. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: Allocation rate
display.description: Bytes allocated on the managed heap per second. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: Thread pool queue length
display.description: Work items queued in the thread pool. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: Thread pool threads
display.description: Active thread pool threads. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: Exception rate
display.description: Managed exceptions thrown per second. Query A: .NET 9+ metric names, query B: .NET 8 names.

display.name: Log volume by severity
display.description: Log record count grouped by severity

display.name: Error and fatal logs
display.description: Log records with severity Error or higher
